_meta.description: Reference contraindication pairs for the Sprint 7 NSCRE Module A (drug-drug interaction check). Illustrative dev subset -- real, well-established prescribing facts (not model-generated), keyed to Medication.key values confirmed to exist in the live PSKG graph (services/veritas-graph/etl_pskg.py) from the synthetic seed data. Production would load a licensed interaction database (e.g. a drug compendium's DDI table), not this hand-curated subset.

pairs.rationale: Concurrent NSAID use increases warfarin's anticoagulant effect and GI bleeding risk (displaces warfarin from plasma protein binding, impairs platelet function).
